answer: The pearl counter is kept in grove and river makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2423 identities would post 4642 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
